name: cache-tax
description: Tells you when the prompt cache has gone cold, what your next message will cost to reload, and keeps it warm on request with /keepwarm.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache survives without a request: 5 for the default cache, 60 for the extended one.

inputPricePerMTok.title: Input price (USD per million tokens)
inputPricePerMTok.description: Your model's base input price. The estimate is only as good as this number.

maxKeepWarmPings.title: Most keep-warm pings per idle stretch
maxKeepWarmPings.description: After this many pings in a row with no message from you, keep-warm stops and lets the cache go cold.
